task: FORECASTBUNDLE RESEARCH GOVERNANCE DECISION RECORD D3

governance_decision_d3.name: SW_IN -> Solar Generation Mapping Authorization
governance_decision_d3.statement: For Stage8.1 integration, the project SHALL use the existing _irradiance_to_power_w() representation mapping as the authorized SW_IN -> solar-generation mapping.

existing_mapping_evidence.limitations: Linear conversion up to 60 kW inverter saturation cap. Does not model cell temperature dynamics or zenith incidence angles.

units_and_semantics.transformation_type: Engineering PV representation mapping (not a scalar unit alias)

relationship_to_d1_d2.integration_rule: Stage8.1 point irradiance forecast mapped to point solar generation array; D2 governs lower=point=upper degenerate bounds.

scientific_claim_limitations: Authorizes engineering representation mapping only. Does not establish empirical PV validation, station yield accuracy, or EMS performance improvement.

d3_frozen_contract_assessment.reasoning: Output of _irradiance_to_power_w() produces non-negative floats in W matching ForecastBundle solar_generation requirements without schema modification.

engineering_consequence_assessment: Future Stage8.1 forecast adapter wrapper may invoke _irradiance_to_power_w() for solar_generation.point.
Preserves both solar_irradiance (W/m^2) and solar_generation (W) in ForecastBundle.
EMS continues receiving ForecastBundle objects without direct coupling to raw Stage8.1 outputs.
